capo.evidence: The front view (e.g., t=7.0s) clearly shows the nut and upper fretboard with no capo clamped on the neck.

tuning.evidence: Tuning cannot be determined from visual frames alone; audio is required to identify the pitches of the strings.

fretting_hand.note: Side view of the guitarist; the left hand moves between approximately frets 2 and 8.
Front view provides a clear look at the fretboard; the hand shifts between low positions (frets 2-6) and high positions (frets 8-12).
Side view returns; the hand stays in the lower-middle position on the neck (frets 3-6).
